description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into 14 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: date (19.30%, green), from (17.00%, blue), to (14.50%, yellow), genre (13.50%, dark green), name (5.20%, dark blue), size (4.20%, brown), intent (3.80%, grey), location (3.80%, light green), destination (3.00%, light blue), city (2.60%, teal), class (2.40%, light brown), range (2.20%, tan), type (2.00%, dark grey), beds (1.30%, black), and passengers (1.10%, light grey). The chart includes percentage labels next to each slice, and the slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions. No legend is present in the chart.
